rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home structure and contents caused by a burst supply line is direct property damage to the insured dwelling.
claim_summary: Sam Patel (POL-1004) reports basement flooded with 2 inches of water due to a burst supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately 2 days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to 1 foot high, and ruined stored boxes. Estimated damage $8,000–$15,000+. High severity; requires immediate on-site assessment and water mitigation.

case_facts.damage_details: hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot high, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately 2 days
case_facts.estimated_damage: likely $8,000–$15,000+ (hardwood floor replacement, drywall repair/replacement, water extraction, contents loss)
